# Functions 
```{r}
# Functions limits and breaks
fun_breaks <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)), length.out = 3)
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1), length.out = 3)
    }
  } else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)), length.out = 3)/10
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1), length.out = 3)/10
    }
  }
}
fun_limits <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)))
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1))
    }
  }  else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)))/10
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1))/10
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Define pathogen
selpat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
              "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
              "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",

# Define vaccination
vac_l <-  case_when(
  selpat_l %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "multi_mmr", "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv") ~ "v1",
  .default = "vl")

# Read in the data 
dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/data_brms_{x}_{vac_l[[x]]}_s08.rds"))}, simplify = FALSE)

df_rhats_cs <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_rhats/df_rhats_cs.rds"))
# Read in the waic

df_minwaic <- bind_rows(df_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  filter(waic == min(waic))
```

```{r}
fun_checkgaps <- function(x) {
  # Sort the vector
  sorted_x <- sort(x)
  # Compute the differences between consecutive elements
  gaps <- diff(sorted_x)
  # Check the gap between the last element and the first element, considering the circularity (52 back to 1)
  circular_gap <- (52 - max(sorted_x)) + (min(sorted_x) - 1)
  # Check if any gap is larger than 25, including the circular gap
  any(gaps > 25) || circular_gap > 25
}
```

# Function to read conditional effects 
```{r}
fun_condeffects <- function(mod = mod, clu_name = NA, multi = FALSE, pat = "rota") {
  
  # Take out gauss if necessary
  clu_name <- str_remove(clu_name, "_gauss")
  
  # Prepare data 
  dat <- mutate(dat_l[[pat]], pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    distinct(vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1)
  pref_clu_name <- if(!is.na(clu_name)) paste0(":", clu_name) else ""
  # Create group vector 
  var_vector <- c()
  
  # Extract conditional effects 
  if(multi) {
    ce_effects <- lapply(
      conditional_effects(mod, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1{pref_clu_name}")),
      as.data.frame) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
      mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=\\.immvals1anti).+?(?=_pi)"))
    # Attach imm_name to group vector 
    var_vector <- c(var_vector, "imm_name")
  } else {
    ce_effects <- conditional_effects(mod, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1{pref_clu_name}"))[[1]]
  }
  
  # Prepare clusters if necessary
  if(!is.na(clu_name)) {
    # Create cluster variable 
    ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(clu_checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Attach cluster to group vector 
    var_vector <- c(var_vector, "clu")
  } else {
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop")
  }
  
  # Obtain estimates 
  ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
    mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    select(pi_vac_week_v1, estimate__, lower__, upper__, all_of(var_vector)) %>%
    left_join(dat, by = join_by(pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    left_join(dat_tot) %>%
    mutate(estimate_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = estimate__),
           lower_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = lower__),
           upper_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = upper__))
  
  return(ce_effects)
}
```

# Read models for a single clustering method
```{r}
# Select only models cs or csi that converged 
df_converged <- filter(df_rhats_cs, Rhat == FALSE, str_detect(mod, "_cs\\.|_csi_")) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod, "reg") ~ sub(".*(reg.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod))) %>%
  filter(pathogen != "multi_pertu")
  
# Obtain the conditional effects for each photo period 
ce_dat_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- if(is.na(df_converged[x, "reg"])) "cs" else paste0("csi_", df_converged[x, "reg"])
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue(
    "{dirs$outputs}/modres_condeffects/ce_dat_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain conditional effects
    ce_dat <- fun_condeffects(mod = mod, clu_name = df_converged[x, "reg"], 
                              multi = str_detect(pat, "multi"), pat = pat)
    return(ce_dat)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(ce_dat_l) <- df_converged$mod
```

```{r}
mod <- "bmvl_s08_rota_csi_reg_3.rds"

# Plot conditional effects 
ce_dat_l[[mod]] %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(estimate__))) + 
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = log(lower__), ymax = log(upper__)), 
                alpha = 0.2, color = "white") + 
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point(data = filter(ce_dat_l[[mod]], !is.na(tot)),
               aes(y = -Inf), alpha = 0.4, shape = "|", size = 6) +
    scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect\non ab titers (log)") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1, 18, 35, 52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
    facet_wrap(.~clu, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(week = 1:52) %>%
              mutate(cos_fun = cos(2*pi*week/52)), aes(x = week, y = 6 + cos_fun/2))
```

# Read models for extracting coefficients 
```{r}
# Obtain the conditional effects for each photo period 
coef_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- if(is.na(df_converged[x, "reg"])) "cs" else paste0("csi_", df_converged[x, "reg"])
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue(
    "{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef/coef_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain conditional effects
    sum_coef <- summary(mod)
    return(sum_coef)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(coef_l) <- df_converged$mod

# Extract coefficients fro the cosine and obtain amplitude and phase
lapply(coef_l, function(x) {
  x$fixed %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "parameter")
}) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin")) %>%
  mutate(param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "cos",
                           str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "sin")) %>%
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(reg_value = str_remove_all(parameter, "reg|_2|_3|_4|_6|cospi_vac_week_v1|sinpi_vac_week_v1|:"),
         reg_value = case_when(reg == "reg_2" & reg_value == "" ~ "1_North",
                               reg %in% c("reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6") & reg_value == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
                               !is.na(reg) & reg_value != "" ~ reg_value,
                               .default = NA)) %>%
  select(pathogen, mod, param, reg, reg_value, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  # Estimate amplitude and phase
  mutate(amp = sqrt((cos^2) + (sin^2)),
         phi = (atan((-1*sin)/(cos)))) %>%
  mutate(phi_week = 52*(phi)/(2*pi)) %>%
  filter(pathogen == "rota")
```

# Predictions 
```{r}
# Predictions of the mean per week 
# Predictions for the single values 
pred_sum_l <- sapply(selpat_l[1], function(x) {
  pred_sum_dat <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/pred_sum_dat_{x}.rds"), {
    pred <- posterior_predict(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 10) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("V")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = draw, values_from = value, names_prefix = "draw_") %>%
      bind_cols(dat_l[[x]] %>%
        rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%  
        select(vac_week_v1, imm_val_s1, clu)) %>%
      rename(vid = name) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("draw_"))) %>%
      group_by(name, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(mean_pred = mean(value),
               sd_pred = sd(value),
               mean_imm = mean(imm_val_s1),
               sd_imm = sd(imm_val_s1),
               tot = n())
    epred <- posterior_epred(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 10) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("V")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = draw, values_from = value, names_prefix = "draw_") %>%
      bind_cols(dat_l[[x]] %>%
        rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%  
        select(vac_week_v1, imm_val_s1, clu)) %>%
      rename(vid = name) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("draw_"))) %>%
      group_by(name, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(mean_epred = mean(value),
                sd_epred = sd(value),
                mean_imm = mean(imm_val_s1),
                sd_imm = sd(imm_val_s1),
                tot = n()) 
    
    all <- left_join(pred, epred) %>%
      rename(draw = name) %>%
      select(draw, vac_week_v1, clu, mean_imm, sd_imm, tot, 
             mean_pred, sd_pred, mean_epred, sd_epred)
    return(all)
  })
  return(pred_sum_dat)
}, simplify = FALSE)

pl_pred_sum <- bind_rows(pred_sum_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pathogen, vac_week_v1, clu, mean_imm, sd_imm, tot) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred_m = mean(mean_pred),
            mean_pred_q2.5 = quantile(mean_pred, probs = 0.025), 
            mean_pred_q97.5 = quantile(mean_pred, probs = 0.975),
            mean_epred_m = mean(mean_epred),
            mean_epred_q2.5 = quantile(mean_epred, probs = 0.025), 
            mean_epred_q97.5 = quantile(mean_epred, probs = 0.975)) %>%
  #filter(clu == clu_name_val) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(mean_imm), size = tot)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = log(mean_epred_m)), size = 1, color = "red", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = log(mean_epred_q2.5), ymax = log(mean_epred_q97.5)), 
                 color = "red", alpha = 0.3,
                 size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) +
  scale_size_continuous("Individuals", breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150, 200)) +
  #facet_grid(pathogen~"Predicted \n ab titers (log) \n summarized \n (per week)", scales = "free") +
  facet_grid(pathogen~clu, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y.right = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())
```
